test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can complete a certain job in 32 days. B is 60% more efficient than A. In how many days can B alone complete the job?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete a certain job in 32 days. B is 60% more efficient than A.

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency of B = Efficiency of A × 1.6

Time taken by B = Time taken by A / Efficiency of B

**Calculation:**

Efficiency of A = 1 unit/day

Efficiency of B = 1 × 1.6 = 1.6 units/day

Time taken by B = (32)/(1.6) 

⇒ (32)/(1.6) = 20 days

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
